tasks.name: describe module exports
tasks.prompt: Inspect vending.js and math.go in the scratch directory. List every exported symbol from both files, and explain in one sentence what computeTotal in vending.js calculates.

input_files.vending.js:
export function computeTotal(items) { return items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.price * (1 - (i.discount || 0)), 0) }
export const TAX_RATE = 0.13

tasks.expected_outcome: a text answer naming computeTotal, TAX_RATE, Min and the discount-applied sum
